boards.title: Your First Weekend at Marywood University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-first sequence of named Marywood destinations for getting oriented, connecting, and winding down safely.

cards.title: 1. Settle into Loughran Hall
cards.subtitle: First-year residence hall · 1406 University Avenue
cards.notes: Use your first stop to get oriented in your residence hall, then identify the study or TV lounge on your floor before heading out.
cards.short_summary: Begin by locating the residential amenities closest to your room.
cards.evidence_claim: Loughran Hall houses freshmen and includes study and TV lounges on every floor plus a 24-hour computer lab.
cards.access_notes: Residence-hall access is intended for residents and their authorized guests; follow Housing & Residence Life guidance.

cards.title: 2. Make the Learning Commons your landmark
cards.subtitle: Library and campus-support hub · 201 Morgan Road
cards.notes: Walk through the building while it is quiet enough to notice the library, student-support offices, and a route you can repeat on Monday.
cards.short_summary: Use a central academic building to anchor your mental map of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons houses the library, orientation, academic-success, archives, tutoring, writing-center, and student-disability services.
cards.access_notes: Check building access and service availability with Marywood, especially during breaks.

cards.title: 3. Find the Knowledge Bar
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons Atrium
cards.notes: Make a quick pass through the atrium and save this location for a future research question, material pickup, or library-service need.
cards.short_summary: Locate the library’s in-person research and materials-service point.
cards.evidence_claim: The Knowledge Bar in the Learning Commons Atrium offers individual research help through the AskHere desk and library material services.
cards.access_notes: Library services are for the Marywood community; confirm desk availability before making a special trip.

cards.title: 4. Take a café pause at Study Grounds
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons café
cards.notes: If you want a snack or beverage, use this stop to learn the café location and check the live dining page for menus and hours.
cards.short_summary: A coffeehouse-style campus café inside the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Grounds is in the Learning Commons and offers Starbucks beverages plus grab-and-go sandwiches and salads.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary during regular semesters, breaks, and summer; consult Marywood Dining before visiting.

cards.title: 5. See what is showing at Mahady Gallery
cards.subtitle: Insalaco Center for Studio Arts
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition and gallery hours, then take a slow lap through the contemporary-art displays before choosing your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gallery with rotating student, faculty, and visiting-artist work.
cards.evidence_claim: Mahady Gallery presents visiting-artist, faculty, student, juried regional, and curated national exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Marywood says its galleries are free and open to the public; check individual gallery hours and exhibition status.

cards.title: 6. Learn where Student Engagement is
cards.subtitle: Room 107 · Nazareth Student Center
cards.notes: Stop by or note the office location, then browse current campus activity and club information rather than relying on old flyers or posts.
cards.short_summary: A practical starting point for current campus involvement information.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Student Engagement is in Room 107 of the Nazareth Student Center, and Marywood reports more than 60 student clubs and organizations.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Engagement | Marywood University
cards.access_notes: Confirm office hours and event details directly with Student Engagement.

cards.title: 7. Try the Nazareth Game Room
cards.subtitle: Nazareth Student Center
cards.notes: Meet up for a low-key round of pool, foosball, shuffleboard, arcade games, or a board game from the nearby Student Engagement Office.
cards.short_summary: A free, named indoor recreation stop in the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood describes its Nazareth Student Center Game Room as an open-floor-plan gaming room with free leisure activities.
cards.access_notes: Availability may depend on student-center access and programming; check locally before planning a group visit.

cards.title: 8. Get familiar with Athletics and Wellness
cards.subtitle: 1501 University Avenue
cards.notes: Walk over to identify the building, then ask the appropriate university office about current recreation access before planning a workout or swim.
cards.short_summary: Locate Marywood’s major indoor recreation and athletics facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Athletics and Wellness houses the Insalaco Arena, Aquatics Center, jogging track, fitness center, climbing wall, dance studio, and locker rooms.
cards.source_title: Center for Athletics and Wellness | Marywood University
cards.access_notes: Facility and activity access can vary; verify current student recreation policies and schedules with Marywood.

cards.title: 9. Have dinner in the Main Dining Room
cards.subtitle: Nazareth Student Center
cards.notes: Use a meal swipe or other accepted payment, and check the current dining listing for service times before walking over for dinner.
cards.short_summary: A central dining-hall stop with multiple food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood’s Main Dining Room is in the Nazareth Student Center and has multiple stations, meal-swipe options, and other payment methods.
cards.access_notes: Marywood lists dinner daily from 4:30–7:00 p.m.; confirm current hours because dining schedules can change.

cards.entity_name: Sette LaVerghetta Center for Performing Arts
cards.title: 10. Check the performing-arts calendar
cards.subtitle: 2300 Adams Avenue · Munley Theatre and Black Box Theatre
cards.notes: End the weekend by checking whether a university performance is scheduled, then plan a return visit around the event’s stated access and ticket details.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for music, theatre, and dance performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood states that its music, theatre, and dance ensembles often perform at the Sette LaVerghetta Center’s Munley Theatre or Black Box Theatre.
cards.source_title: Sette LaVerghetta Center for Performing Arts | Marywood University
cards.access_notes: Performance dates, admission, and venue access vary by event; use Marywood’s current event information before attending.
